about: An Egyptian governor, sent to Solomon by Pharaoh, reports that the men of Ethiopia passed through Egypt with music and carts, that the Egyptian gods fell and were broken as they entered, and that the Egyptian priests lay it to the Ark of the God of Israel. He reproaches Solomon for giving the Ark away, and Solomon answers evasively.

sentences.i: Chapter 59: Where he questioned the Egyptian, Pharaoh's servant
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፶፱ is the numeral 59 (፶ 50, ፱ 9). The heading has the shape of those of chs. 49, 53 and 54: ኀበ 'where, at the point where' + a perfect verb. ሐተቶ is ሐተተ 'to question, examine' in the 3ms perfect with the object suffix -ኦ 'him' (so ዘሐተቶ in ch. 23); the object is then named with ለ-, ለግብጻዊ 'the Egyptian' — the regular way of doubling an object suffix, as ባረኮ ... ለወልዱ in the heading of ch. 49. The subject is not named: Solomon, who does the questioning in this chapter. ግብጻዊ is 'Egyptian' (ግብጽ 'Egypt' + the adjectival ending -ዊ); ገብረ ፈርዖን stands in apposition to it, a construct chain in which ገብር 'servant' becomes ገብረ before the dependent noun.

sentences.i: He went on from there and found one of the governors of Egypt, a governor of King Pharaoh's, whom Pharaoh had sent to him with gifts and a full store of goods with him; and he arrived and bowed down before the king.
sentences.n: The subject of ወኀለፈ and ወረከበ is not named: Solomon himself, who in ch. 58 rose and set out after the Ethiopians (?). ወ- 'and' on each verb (ወኀለፈ, ወረከበ, ወበጽሐ, ወሰገደ) strings simple perfects, and the subject shifts inside the unit: the one who arrives and bows is the governor. እም- in እምህየ and እመኳንንተ is 'from', and before a plural it is partitive, 'one of the governors'. መኰንነ is the accusative of መኰንን 'governor'; መኳንንት is its broken plural, here in the construct before ግብጽ. ዘንጉሥ ፈርዖን: ዘ- 'of, who belongs to'. ዘለአኮ: ዘ- relative 'whom' + ለአኮ 'he sent him' (ለአከ with the 3ms object suffix -ኦ); the sender is Pharaoh. ምሉእ ንዋይ 'full goods', that is a full load of goods of every kind (?). ሰገደ is 'to bow down, prostrate oneself', and ለንጉሥ names the one bowed to.

sentences.l: And-hastened-him to-question Solomon the-king before he-give his-gifts and-his-message, and-said-to-him: Is-there that-you-saw men-of Ethiopia while they-travel from-there?
sentences.i: King Solomon hurried to question him before he could hand over his gifts and his message, and said to him, 'Did you see the men of Ethiopia travelling away from there?'
sentences.n: ወአፍጠኖ ሐቲተ: አፍጠነ is the causative (A-stem) of ፈጠነ 'be quick', so 'he hastened'; ሐቲተ is its accusative infinitive, 'the questioning'. The suffix -ኦ 'him' on the verb is the object of that infinitive, carried back onto the governing verb: 'he hastened to question him'. ዘእንበለ 'before, without' takes the subjunctive የሀብ 'he give' (ወሀበ 'to give'); the suffixes in አምኃሁ 'his gifts' and መልእክቶ 'his message' are the 3ms -ሁ / -ኦ. ወይቤሎ: ይቤ 'he said' + -ሎ 'to him', the standing formula. ቦኑ: ቦ 'there is' + the question particle -ኑ, 'is it that?'. ዘርኢከ 'that you saw' (ርእየ). ሰብአ ኢትዮጵያ: construct, 'men-of Ethiopia', as the published parts render it. እንዘ ይግዕዙ: እንዘ 'while' + the imperfect, 'while they were travelling' (ገዐዘ 'to go, journey, migrate' (?)); the same root gives the language-name Geʿez.

sentences.i: 'they arrived last Tuesday at the Takkaze, the river of Egypt, sounding their harps (?) and racing in carts like a heavenly host;
sentences.n: እንተ ኀለፈት ሠሉስ: 'the Tuesday that passed', that is last Tuesday; ሠሉስ is the 'third' day, Tuesday, as ch. 57–58 has it (ሠሉስ ዕለት), and እንተ is the feminine relative, agreeing with ዕለት 'day' understood. ተከዚ is the Takkaze (Tekezé), the Ethiopian river; the published parts meet the same oddity of its standing in Egypt (chs. 53, 57–58). ፈለገ ምስር: construct, 'river-of Egypt' (ምስር is another name for Egypt), so the Nile (?). እንዘ ይነፍሑ 'while they blow' (ነፍሐ 'to blow'); ዕንዚራት is 'harps' in the published parts, where it is taken as a stringed instrument (?) — ነፍሐ 'blow' points rather to a wind instrument, so the instrument stays uncertain (?). በ- 'with, in'. ይረውጹ 'they run' (ሮጸ). ሰረገላት 'carts, chariots': the published parts call the Ethiopians' flying vehicle a cart. ከመ ኀይለ ሰማያዊያን: ኀይል 'power, army, host' in the construct; ሰማያዊያን 'heavenly ones' (ሰማይ + -ዊ + the plural -ያን).

sentences.i: 'Those who saw them said, “These men are of the earth, yet they have become heavenly. Who is wiser than Solomon, king of Judah? Even he never travelled in a cart of wind (?) like this.”
sentences.n: ወእለ ርእይዎሙ: እለ is the plural relative 'those who' + ርእይዎሙ 'they saw them' (ርእየ with the suffix -ዎሙ 'them'). ይቤልዎሙ 'they said to them'; who the addressees are is not stated (?). እሉሰ: the enclitic -ሰ marks contrast, 'as for these'. እንዘ is concessive here ('although') before a verbless clause; መሬታዊያን 'earthly ones' (መሬት 'earth, dust'). ኮኑ 'they became' (ኮነ). መኑኬ 'who then?' (መኑ 'who?' + the emphatic -ኬ). ይጠብብ እም-: the comparative, 'is wiser than' (ጠበበ). ንጉሠ ይሁዳ: construct. ወውእቱኒ ኢሖረ 'and he too did not go' (ሖረ with the negative ኢ-). ነፉስ is the printed spelling of ነፋስ 'wind', as in chs. 51–52, 55–56 and 57–58; በሰረገላ ነፉስ 'in a cart of wind (?)', the flying cart of those chapters. ከመዝ 'like this'.

sentences.i: 'Those who were in the cities and the tower (?) became witnesses that, when these men came into the land of Egypt, our gods fell and were broken, and the gods of the king too; and the tower of the idols was likewise crushed.
sentences.n: ወእለ ሀለዉ 'and those who were' (ሀለወ 'to be, be present'). ማኅፈድ is 'tower' in the published parts (and strained there too: ch. 36); here it is a building of the idols, a temple tower or precinct (?), and it returns in the construct as ማኅፈደ ጣዖታት. ስምዐ ኮኑ: ስምዕ 'witness, testimony' in the accusative as predicate of ኮኑ 'they became'. ከመ ሶበ ቦኡ 'that when they entered' (ቦኡ, the 3mp of ቦአ). ወድቁ 'they fell' (ወድቀ); ተሰብሩ is the T-stem passive of ሰበረ 'to break', 'they were broken'; the subject of both is አማልክቲነ 'our gods' (አማልክት, the plural of አምላክ, + -ነ 'our'). The -ኒ in ጣዖታትኒ is 'also, too'. ተቀጥቀጡ is the T-stem of the quadriliteral ቀጥቀጠ, 'they were crushed'; the plural verb shows the subject read as ጣዖታት 'idols', though ማኅፈደ before it is singular (?). ከማሁ 'likewise'.

sentences.i: 'The servants of the gods, the ማርያን (?) of Egypt, asked why our gods had fallen, and told us, “The Ark of the God of Israel, which came down from heaven, is with them and stays in their country forever.
sentences.n: ወሐተቱ 'and they questioned, inquired' (ሐተተ, as in ch. 57–58). ገነውተ አማልክት: construct, 'servants-of gods', that is the priests of the idols (the lemma is uncertain (?)). The construct form leaves the case open, so the clause may equally be 'and they questioned the priests of the gods ... and they (the priests) said to us' (?); the sense is the same either way. ማርያነ ግብጽ is uncertain (?): ማርያን may be 'leaders, elders', or the name of a class of priests or diviners; the text gives no way to decide, so it is left in Geʿez, as the published parts leave their unknown words. በእንተ ዘወድቁ 'concerning that they fell' (ዘ- + a perfect makes a noun clause, 'the falling'). ወይቤሉነ: ይቤሉ 'they said' + -ነ 'to us'. ታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤል is a double construct, 'the Ark-of the God-of Israel'; ታቦት, the Ark of the covenant (Zion), is the theological centre of the book, and 'which came down from heaven' is its heavenly Zion, the pattern 'shown on the mountain' (Exodus 25:40). እንተ ወረደት: the feminine relative + 'she came down'; the Ark is grammatically feminine, hence ሀለወት 'she is' and ትነብር 'she dwells' (ነበረ). ምስሌሆሙ 'with them', ሀገሮሙ 'their country'. እስከ ለዓለም 'for ever'.

sentences.n: ወአንተሰ: the contrastive -ሰ, 'but as for you'. አልቦ ዘይመስላ ለጥበብከ: አልቦ 'there is not'; ዘይመስላ 'what resembles it', with the object suffix -ኣ referring to ጥበብ 'wisdom' (feminine, as the published glossary has it) and ለ- resuming it: 'there is nothing like your wisdom'. እምታሕተ ሰማይ 'from under heaven', that is anywhere. ወለምንት 'and why?' (ለ- + ምንት 'what'). ወሀብከ 'you gave' (ወሀበ). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር: the possessor of the construct ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark-of his law' is anticipated by -ሁ and then named with ለ-, the device already met in ሀገሩ ለንጉሥ. ዘአንጽሑ: ዘ- 'which' + አንጽሑ, the 3mp perfect of አንጽሐ, the causative (A-stem) of ነጽሐ 'be clean, pure', so 'which they sanctified'; the verb carries no object suffix — what was sanctified is the ark, the antecedent of ዘ-. ለከ 'for you'; አበዊከ 'your fathers' is the subject, placed last.

sentences.tr: ʾəsmä nəsämʿ kämä yəʾti tadḫənäkmu ʾəmʾədä ṣ́ärkəmu wämänfäsä tənbitni bati yətnagäräkmu wäʾämlakä sämayniʾä yäḫädr wəsteta bämänfäsu qədus wätsämäyu säbʾä betu läʾgəziʾabḥer
sentences.l: For we-hear that she will-save-you from-hand-of your-enemy, and-spirit-of prophecy too in-her speaks-to-you, and-God-of heaven too dwells within-her by-his spirit holy, and-you-are-called people-of his-house, of God;
sentences.i: 'For we hear that she saves you from the hand of your enemy, that the spirit of prophecy speaks to you through her, that the God of heaven dwells within her by his Holy Spirit, and that you are called the people of God's house.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'. ንሰምዕ 'we hear' (ሰምዐ, 1cp imperfect). ከመ 'that' introduces what is heard; ይእቲ 'she' (the Ark). ታድኅነክሙ: ታድኅን is the causative (A-stem) of ድኅነ 'be safe', so 'she saves'; -ክሙ 'you' is plural, the Israelites. እምእደ ፀርክሙ 'from the hand-of your enemy' (እድ 'hand' in the construct). መንፈሰ ትንቢት 'spirit of prophecy'. ባቲ 'in, through her'. ይትናገረክሙ 'speaks to you': ተናገረ is the T-stem of ነገረ 'to tell'. ሰማይኒአ: -ኒ 'too' with a final -አ that nothing accounts for; the published parts meet the same stray -አ (ወሀበነአ, ch. 36) and keep it as printed (?). የኀድር 'dwells' (ኀደረ), ውስቴታ 'within her', በመንፈሱ ቅዱስ 'by his holy spirit' (the adjective following the suffixed noun; a Christian reading of the Ark). ትሰመዩ: the T-stem passive of ሰምየ 'to name', 'you are called'. ሰብአ ቤቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'people-of his house, of God' (the anticipatory suffix again); cf. Ephesians 2:19, 'members of the household of God' (?).

sentences.i: Why have you given your glory to a stranger?'
sentences.n: ወለምንት ዘወሀብክሙ: ዘ- is the relative used after 'why' to give 'why is it that you gave'; the verb is plural (-ክሙ) though it addresses Solomon, so the speaker means Solomon with his people (?). ክብርክሙ 'your glory, your honour': the Ark is the glory of Israel, and ክብር is the book's own title word (ክብረ ነገሥት); the reproach echoes Isaiah 42:8, 'my glory I give to no other' (?). ለባዕድ 'to a stranger, a foreigner' (ባዕድ 'other').

sentences.l: Answered in-wisdom Solomon and-said: By-where can taking-her, to-our-lady, since she-is with-us?
sentences.i: Solomon answered with wisdom and said, 'How could anyone take our Lady away, when she is here with us?'
sentences.n: አውሥአ በጥበብ ሰሎሞን: Solomon is the subject, placed after the adverbial 'with wisdom'. ወይቤ 'and he said'. በአይቴ ይክል ነሢኦታ: በአይቴ 'by what way? how?' (አይቴ 'where'); ይክል 'he is able' (ከህለ); ነሢኦታ is the infinitive ነሢኦት 'taking' (accusative ነሢኦተ) with the suffix -ኣ 'her', written ታ; no subject is expressed, so 'how could one take her' (?). ለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት is the feminine of እግዚእ, 'lady', + -ነ 'our'; ለ- marks the object, doubling the suffix of ነሢኦታ, and 'our Lady' is a title of the Ark (and of Zion). እስመ ሀለወት ኀቤነ 'since she is with us' (ኀቤነ from ኀበ + -ነ). Solomon is evasive: he neither admits nor denies that the Ark has gone. The final ፨ ፨ closes the part.

glossary.ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ወተሰብሩ: ተሰብረ — and they were broken (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt passive of ሰበረ)
glossary.ወትሰመዩ: ተሰምየ — and you are called (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, Gt passive of ሰምየ)
glossary.ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect) · also 2ms 'and you will dwell' (ወትነብር ውስተ ብሔርነ)
glossary.ወኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — and he passed, went by (ወ- + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ወነዋ: ነዋ — and behold, here is (ወ- + interjection ነዋ)
glossary.ወአማልክተ: አምላክ — and gods of (ወ- + plural አማልክት, construct)
glossary.ወአምላከ: አምላክ — and God of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወአፍጠኖ: አፍጠነ — and he hastened (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ፈጠነ 'be quick', + -ኦ 'him', the object of the following infinitive ሐቲተ)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወይረውጹ: ሮጸ — and they run, race (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, r-w-ṣ)
glossary.ወይቤሉነ: ብህለ — and they said to us (ወ- + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ + -ነ '1cp to us')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዘለአኮ: ለአከ — whom he sent (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ለአከ + -ኦ 'him', written ለአኮ)
glossary.ዘርኢከ: ርእየ — which you saw (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘትብል: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect ትብል, b-h-l)
glossary.ዘንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — of the king (ዘ- genitive + noun)
glossary.ዘአንጽሑ: አንጽሐ — which they sanctified, made clean (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, causative of ነጽሐ 'be clean, pure'; no object suffix — the object is the antecedent of ዘ-)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘወሀብክሙ: ወሀበ — that you gave (ዘ- + 2mp perfect, G, w-h-b)
glossary.ዘወድቁ: ወድቀ — that they fell (ዘ- + 3mp perfect, G; ዘ- as 'the fact that' after በእንተ)
glossary.ዘይመስላ: መሰለ — who resembles her/it (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect ይመስል + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.የሀብ: ወሀበ — he gives (3ms imperfect/jussive, G, w-h-b; after ዘእንበለ)
glossary.ይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — they said to them (3mp perfect ይቤሉ + -ዎሙ 'to them', b-h-l)
glossary.ይትናገረክሙ: ተናገረ — he/it speaks to you (3ms imperfect, T-stem of ነገረ 'to tell', + -ክሙ '2mp to you')
glossary.ይነፍሑ: ነፍሐ — they blow (3mp imperfect, G, n-f-ḥ)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
glossary.ይክል: ከህለ — he is able (3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l; with infinitive)
glossary.ይግዕዙ: ገዐዘ — they go away, depart, travel (3mp imperfect after እንዘ, G, g-ʿ-z) (?)
glossary.ይጠብብ: ጠበበ — he is wise (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh'
glossary.ገነውተ: ገነውት (?) — servants, priests of the gods (noun, plural, construct 'servants-of'; the singular and so the dictionary form are uncertain, behind it a verb ገነወ 'to serve, worship' (?))
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53)
glossary.፶፱: ፶፱ — 59, spoken ኀምሳ ወተስዐቱ (ḫämsa wä-täsʿatu) 'fifty-nine'; chapter number (numeral)
